dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: I understand. When you embark on an adventure, you can come across a variety of situations anywhere you go. And rainforests and deserts are infested with quite some strange things.

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: But I'm not going to sea again anytime soon. I'll just wait and see.

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: This bow is of little use to me now. Do you wish to take it?

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: I thought ranged weapons like this might be useful at sea or on a deserted island, or even for bowfishing.

dialogues.speaker: Vasco
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it... Nah. Perhaps I should take it one step at a time and learn to use a dagger first.
